answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in lantern, expire in ledge, and thread lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 172 aliases therefore needs 42 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 194 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
